name: Tremor
text:
You unleash a small, localized tremor in a 10-foot burst within 30 feet. Each creature in the area takes ceil(@actor.level/2d8) bludgeoning damage with a basic Fortitude save save against your class DC. A creature that critically fails is knocked Prone. Earth and stone in the area is difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.

---
Level (+2) The damage increases by 1d8.
